messages:
ada: Quick note: reproducible DX issue in Python SDK async embeddings used by the embeddings+rerank sample app. Single-input async responses sometimes get unwrapped to a flat vector and rerank crashes.

cole: Can you paste a minimal repro and error?

ada: Repro (async):
```
res = await client.embeddings.create(model='embed-1', input='hello')
print(type(res.data), len(res.data))
print(res.data[0])
```
Expected: list containing one list-of-floats. Actual: intermittently res.data is a flat list-of-floats -> rerank._prepare_docs does `for doc in docs` and hits TypeError.

qa-bot: Issue created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/551 "async embeddings: singleton unwrapped causing rerank shape mismatch". Added label: dx.

cole: Root cause: async normalizer calls _maybe_unwrap_singletons; sync path does not. Race with batching yields nondeterministic shapes.

ada: Proposed fix: 1) normalize inputs at call entry (wrap singletons), 2) ensure outputs are always list-of-items (remove unwrap), 3) add unit+integration tests and doc snippet for onboarding.

docs-bot: I'll add onboarding note: `inputs = [inputs] if isinstance(inputs, str) else inputs` and update sampleapp code.

cole: Opening PR with tests + changelog note. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
